item.title: Fox Lake couple arrested, charged with abuse of 11-year-old boy, police say
item.description: Two residents of northwest suburban Fox Lake have been arrested and charged following an investigation into the apparent abuse of an 11-year-old boy, according to the Fox Lake Police Department.

item.title: Morton Grove condo collapse leads to structural inspections of other buildings
item.description: A partial condo collapse in Morton Grove over the weekend has been attributed to a single support column in an underground garage, and the village is now inspecting other buildings with similar structures to ensure their safety.

item.title: Tiffany Henyard ordered to pay $10K as she eyes Georgia elected office
item.description: Tiffany Henyard, who was ousted as Dolton mayor, has qualified as a Republican candidate for a seat on the Fulton County, Georgia, board of commissioners, despite a long list of grievances, bills, and legal judgements left in her wake.

item.title: Chicago Bears Free Agency Tracker: Who's coming, who's going and who's staying
item.description: The Chicago Bears are in the midst of NFL free agency, signing Devin Bush, Coby Bryant, and Neville Gallimore, while Tremaine Edmunds is signing with the New York Giants and Olamide Zaccheaus is signing with the Atlanta Falcons, with Case Keenum and D'Marco Jackson re-signing with the Bears.
